description: Host side of the detail tab (depends on FEAT-001): detail message protocol, user-facing messages, the pure DetailController (fetch via the existing PkgGoDevSearchClient, timeout, stale protection, GOOS change, retry, installed flag, install/uninstall stub log), the pure buildDetailHtml shell with strict CSP, the 'select' result-click message from the Search view, the single-tab DetailPanelManager (module-level single panel reference, reveal on re-click, cleared on dispose), and extension.ts wiring including installed-state refresh on go.mod changes. The webview script itself comes in FEAT-003, so media/detail.js is only referenced by URI here. See .agents/tasks/detail-tab-plan.md sections 2, 3, 5.
steps: Create src/core/detailProtocol.ts with DetailViewModel, HostToDetail, DetailToHost exactly as in plan section 5, an EMPTY_DETAIL_STATE ({status:'idle', path:'', installed:false, mainLoading:false}) and parseDetailMessage(value: unknown): DetailToHost | undefined (never throws; returns new objects with only allowed keys; changeGoos.goos must match /^[a-z0-9]{1,16}$/; openLink.url must be a string <= 2048 chars that new URL() parses with protocol http:/https:/mailto:, result carries url.href). Style reference: parseWebviewMessage in src/core/searchProtocol.ts.

Modify src/core/messages.ts: add DETAIL_TIMED_OUT ('Loading the package page timed out. Try again.'), DETAIL_BAD_PAGE ('pkg.go.dev returned a page this extension could not read.'), DETAIL_NOT_FOUND ('This package was not found on pkg.go.dev.'), DETAIL_INVALID_PATH ('This package path is not valid.'), detailLoading(path) ('Loading <path>\u2026'), detailFailureLog(ts, path, goos|undefined, failure) and installStubLog(ts, action:'install'|'uninstall', path) ('<ts> <Action> requested for <path>: not implemented yet.'). Reuse UNREACHABLE and httpError(status). Follow the existing function style (see searchFailureLog/openFailedLog).

Create src/core/detailController.ts implementing DetailController per plan section 5: deps {client: SearchClient (from searchController.ts), output: OutputLike, isInstalled(path: string): boolean, timers?: TimerApi (from debouncer.ts), now?, timeoutMs? default 20_000}; `state` getter, `snapshot(): HostToDetail` ({type:'state', state}), `onDidChange(listener)` returning a disposable (listener errors are caught and logged like SearchController.setState), show(path), changeGoos(goos), retry(), refreshInstalled(), requestInstall(), requestUninstall(), reset(), dispose(). Behaviour: show() validates with isValidImportPath (invalid -> status 'error' with DETAIL_INVALID_PATH, no fetch); same path while status is 'loading' or 'ready' is a no-op; otherwise emits state{loading} synchronously then fetches packageDetailUrl(path) (src/core/detailUrl.ts) with a per-request AbortController + timer, generation counter ignoring stale responses and aborting the previous request; on ok -> parsePackageDetail(html, path); undefined -> error DETAIL_BAD_PAGE; ready state sets goos = detail.buildContext?.selected and installed = isInstalled(path). changeGoos(goos) only when status is 'ready' and goos is one of detail.buildContext.options values: emits state{mainLoading:true, error:undefined}, fetches packageDetailUrl(path, goos); success replaces detail and goos; failure keeps the old detail, sets mainLoading false and error to the failure text (inline). retry(): status 'error' -> refetch the same path; status 'ready' with an inline error -> repeat the last requested GOOS. Failure mapping: unreachable -> UNREACHABLE; http 404 -> DETAIL_NOT_FOUND; other http/redirectBlocked -> httpError(status); timeout -> DETAIL_TIMED_OUT; each failure writes one detailFailureLog line to output. refreshInstalled() recomputes installed from isInstalled(path) and emits {type:'installed'} only when the value changed (no-op when idle). requestInstall/Uninstall write one installStubLog line and change nothing else. reset() aborts in-flight work and returns to EMPTY_DETAIL_STATE (emits state). No vscode import.

Create src/core/detailHtml.ts exporting buildDetailHtml(cspSource, nonce, cssUri, jsUri): string: CSP exactly `default-src 'none'; style-src ${cspSource}; script-src 'nonce-${nonce}'; img-src https: data: ${cspSource}; font-src ${cspSource}`; body = div#detail-root containing div#detail-status (role=status aria-live=polite), div#detail-error (role=alert hidden), header#detail-header, main#detail-main; one `<script nonce src>` and one stylesheet link; <title>Package details</title>. No inline script/style.

Modify src/core/searchProtocol.ts: add `| { readonly type: 'select'; readonly path: string }` to WebviewToHost and a 'select' case to parseWebviewMessage that requires a string path passing isValidImportPath (src/core/detailUrl.ts) and returns {type:'select', path} only; invalid -> undefined. Modify src/webview/render.ts buildResult to also set `data-path` = entry.path on the .result-button. Modify src/webview/search.ts click handler to read `data-path` from the button and post {type:'select', path} (no longer `open`; keep resultsVersion/index parsing out of this handler). Leave SearchController.open and the `open` message type untouched.

Modify src/vscode/searchViewProvider.ts: add an exported `DetailOpener { show(path: string): void }` and an optional 4th constructor parameter `detail?: DetailOpener`; in the message switch add `case 'select': this.detail?.show(message.path); break;` (keep `open` handling). Existing 3-arg constructions in tests keep working.

Create src/vscode/detailPanelManager.ts: DetailPanelManager implements vscode.Disposable and `DetailOpener`. Constructor (extensionUri: vscode.Uri, controller: DetailController, openExternal: (url: string) => PromiseLike<boolean>, createPanel: PanelFactory = defaultCreatePanel). `PanelLike` = the slice of WebviewPanel used (webview {options, html, cspSource, asWebviewUri, postMessage, onDidReceiveMessage}, title, iconPath, reveal(column?, preserveFocus?), onDidDispose, dispose). defaultCreatePanel calls vscode.window.createWebviewPanel('gogetManager.detail', 'Package details', vscode.ViewColumn.Active, {enableScripts: true, retainContextWhenHidden: true, localResourceRoots: [media]}). ONE panel: `private panel: PanelLike | undefined`; show(path): if panel exists -> panel.reveal(undefined, true) else create it (set iconPath to imgs/goget-manager-icon.png, html = buildDetailHtml(cspSource, randomBytes(16).toString('base64') nonce, asWebviewUri(media/detail.css), asWebviewUri(media/detail.js))) and subscribe: webview.onDidReceiveMessage -> parseDetailMessage -> ready: post controller.snapshot(); changeGoos -> controller.changeGoos; retry -> controller.retry; install/uninstall -> controller.requestInstall/Uninstall; openLink -> openExternal(Uri.parse(url, true)) with errors swallowed and logged via the controller output? (keep simple: catch and ignore); controller.onDidChange -> post message and update panel.title to the current path when state.path != ''; panel.onDidDispose -> dispose subscriptions, `this.panel = undefined`, controller.reset(). Then call controller.show(path) AFTER the panel exists. Posting is `void Promise.resolve(webview.postMessage(m)).catch(() => undefined)`. Expose `get isOpen(): boolean`. dispose() disposes the panel and subscriptions.

Modify src/extension.ts: create `detailController = new DetailController({client: new PkgGoDevSearchClient(nodeHttpsTransport), output, isInstalled: (path) => isInstalledPackage(path, new Set(collectInstalledModulePaths(repository.snapshot())))})` (import isInstalledPackage from ./core/installedMatch), `detailManager = new DetailPanelManager(context.extensionUri, detailController, (url) => vscode.env.openExternal(vscode.Uri.parse(url, true)))`, pass `detailManager` as the 4th argument of SearchViewProvider, subscribe `repository.onDidChange(() => detailController.refreshInstalled())`, and push detailController, detailManager and that subscription to context.subscriptions. Do not change createTestApi.

Modify test/unit/vscodeStub.ts: add `export enum ViewColumn { Active = -1, Beside = -2, One = 1, Two = 2, Three = 3 }` (the manager only references vscode.ViewColumn inside defaultCreatePanel, but typecheck/imports must still work under the alias).

Add tests: test/unit/detailProtocol.test.ts (parseDetailMessage valid/invalid cases: unknown type, non-objects, goos 'windows' ok / 'Win dows' / '' / 17 chars rejected, openLink https/http/mailto ok and javascript:/file:/data:/non-string/oversized rejected, extra keys dropped, getters that throw -> undefined); test/unit/detailHtml.test.ts (CSP string, nonce on the only script tag, no inline handlers, uris present); test/unit/detailController.test.ts (use fake client + fakeTimers.ts like searchController.test.ts: show -> loading then ready with goos selected and installed flag; invalid path; same-path re-show no refetch; error then re-show/retry refetches; stale response ignored when a newer show() starts; previous request aborted; timeout -> DETAIL_TIMED_OUT; 404 -> DETAIL_NOT_FOUND; unreachable; bad page -> DETAIL_BAD_PAGE; changeGoos requests the URL with ?GOOS=windows, sets mainLoading then replaces detail, on failure keeps detail + inline error + retry repeats the GOOS request; changeGoos with a value not in options ignored; refreshInstalled emits 'installed' only on change; requestInstall/Uninstall write one log line and change no state; reset returns to idle; dispose silences emissions). Use the FEAT-001 fixture test/fixtures/package-detail/sftp-sample.html as the fake client's html. test/unit/detailPanelManager.test.ts (fake createPanel returning a FakePanel recording reveal/postMessage/dispose; first show() creates exactly one panel with enableScripts, retainContextWhenHidden and localResourceRoots=[media]; second show() with another path creates NO new panel and calls reveal(undefined, true); webview 'ready' posts the snapshot; controller changes are posted; changeGoos/retry/install messages routed; openLink calls openExternal only for valid messages; invalid messages ignored; dispose of the panel clears the reference so the next show() creates a new panel and the controller was reset). Update existing tests: test/unit/searchView.test.ts click test now expects {type:'select', path} (give the fake button a data-path attribute); test/unit/render.test.ts assert data-path; test/unit/searchMessages.test.ts and test/unit/searchViewProvider.test.ts add 'select' cases (valid path forwarded to a fake DetailOpener, invalid path ignored, `open` still routed to the controller); test/unit/properties/sp12-webview-messages.test.ts: extend the reference model/arbitraries for 'select' only if the file's structure requires it for the suite to pass.
Run `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build`; fix everything. Commit locally staging explicit paths only, message `feat: open a single reusable package detail tab from search results`.
acceptance_criteria: `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npm run build` exit 0
Clicking a result in the Search view posts {type:'select', path}; the provider forwards only valid import paths to DetailOpener.show

DetailPanelManager creates at most one panel: a second show() reveals (reveal(undefined, true)) instead of creating a new one, and after the panel is disposed the next show() creates a new one (covered by detailPanelManager.test.ts)

DetailController tests cover loading -> ready, errors with retry, stale-response ignoring, GOOS change with main-only loading and failure revert, installed refresh, and the install/uninstall stub logging
buildDetailHtml emits the strict CSP with nonce and no inline script or style
extension.ts wires installed refresh through repository.onDidChange and passes the detail manager to SearchViewProvider; all pre-existing tests still pass
findings: Committed on branch feat/detail-tab (9ef1f00, not pushed). VERIFICATION: `npm run typecheck` exit 0. `npm run build` exit 0 (dist/extension.js, media/search.js emitted; media/detail.js not yet, that is FEAT-003). `npm test`: 582 passed, 1 failed; the single failure is the PRE-EXISTING test/unit/searchSmoke.test.ts 'media/search.css contains no hard-coded colors' (flags `border: 1px solid var(--vscode-contrastBorder, transparent)`; media/search.css not touched by this FEAT; same failure recorded in FEAT-001). New tests: detailProtocol, detailHtml, detailController, detailPanelManager; updated searchView/render/searchMessages/searchViewProvider tests. NOTE: test/unit/searchSmoke.test.ts forbids the text `fetch(` in any src file, so DetailController's private request method is named `request`, not `fetch`. EXPORTS FOR FEAT-003: src/core/detailProtocol.ts: types DetailViewModel {status:'idle'|'loading'|'ready'|'error', path, detail?: PackageDetail, goos?, installed, mainLoading, error?}, HostToDetail ({type:'state',state}|{type:'installed',installed}), DetailToHost ({type:'ready'}|{type:'changeGoos',goos}|{type:'openLink',url}|{type:'retry'}|{type:'install'}|{type:'uninstall'}), const EMPTY_DETAIL_STATE, parseDetailMessage(value). src/core/detailHtml.ts: buildDetailHtml(cspSource, nonce, cssUri, jsUri). src/core/detailController.ts: DetailController (show, changeGoos, retry, refreshInstalled, requestInstall, requestUninstall, reset, dispose, state, snapshot(), onDidChange(listener)), interface DetailControllerDeps. src/core/messages.ts additions: DETAIL_TIMED_OUT, DETAIL_BAD_PAGE, DETAIL_NOT_FOUND, DETAIL_INVALID_PATH, detailLoading(path) ('Loading <path>\u2026', for the webview/status text), detailFailureLog, installStubLog. src/vscode/detailPanelManager.ts: DetailPanelManager(extensionUri, controller, openExternal, createPanel?), isOpen, show(path), dispose(); PanelLike, PanelFactory. src/vscode/searchViewProvider.ts: DetailOpener {show(path)}, optional 4th ctor arg. HTML ELEMENT IDS in the shell (buildDetailHtml): div#detail-root > div#detail-status[role=status aria-live=polite], div#detail-error[role=alert hidden], header#detail-header, main#detail-main; one <script nonce src=media/detail.js> and <link rel=stylesheet href=media/detail.css>; the webview must create its own content (title/sections/loading bar/Retry/Install button id `detail-action`) inside these. CSP: default-src 'none'; style-src ${cspSource}; script-src 'nonce-..'; img-src https: data: ${cspSource}; font-src ${cspSource} (no inline styles, so no style= attributes and no element.style assignments that CSP blocks: use classes / `hidden`). HOST BEHAVIOUR THE WEBVIEW RELIES ON: webview must post {type:'ready'} on load and host replies with the full {type:'state'} snapshot; every state change is a full {type:'state', state} message (including loading, mainLoading and inline error); {type:'installed'} is sent only when the installed flag changes while status is 'ready' (webview should only update the Install/Uninstall button). Page error: status 'error' with `error` text and `path`; inline GOOS error: status 'ready' with `error` set, mainLoading false, `detail` and `goos` still the old values (select must show state.goos), Retry posts {type:'retry'}. `goos` is detail.buildContext?.selected (fallback requested GOOS); changeGoos is only honoured by the host when the value is one of detail.buildContext.options[].value. The host sets panel.title to state.path whenever path != ''. Links: webview posts {type:'openLink', url} (http/https/mailto only; host normalises), sanitized fragment hrefs are `#pd-<encodeURIComponent(id)>` and should be handled locally in the webview. Install/Uninstall post {type:'install'}/{type:'uninstall'} with no path. SEARCH WIRING: result buttons now carry `data-path` (entry.path) and src/webview/search.ts click handler posts {type:'select', path} (no longer `open`; `open` message type and SearchController.open remain, untested paths unchanged); parseWebviewMessage validates select.path with isValidImportPath. extension.ts: DetailController uses PkgGoDevSearchClient(nodeHttpsTransport) and isInstalled via isInstalledPackage(path, new Set(collectInstalledModulePaths(repository.snapshot()))); `repository.onDidChange(() => detailController.refreshInstalled())` subscribed; detailController, detailManager and that subscription pushed to context.subscriptions; detailManager passed as 4th SearchViewProvider arg. DEVIATIONS/DETAILS: (1) DetailPanelManager.PanelLike.iconPath typed as vscode.WebviewPanel['iconPath'] (typecheck). (2) detailFailureLog accepts SearchFailure | {kind:'badPage'} (adds an 'unrecognised page' log line for bad pages). (3) show() with an invalid path sets status 'error' with DETAIL_INVALID_PATH and path sliced to 512 chars; retry() on that does nothing. (4) retry() in status 'ready' repeats the last changeGoos request only when an inline error is set. (5) Same-path show() is a no-op only in 'loading'/'ready'; refreshInstalled() is a no-op unless status is 'ready'. (6) reset() (tab closed) emits the idle state but the manager has already unsubscribed so nothing is posted to the closed webview. (7) install/uninstall requests are only logged when a path is set (not idle). (8) No WebviewPanelSerializer (tab is not restored after reload). (9) Not run: npm run test:integration, manual F5 checks (webview script not built yet).
